tokens.npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit_bio:
Lost within the Wailing Mountains, the Fortress of Flares lay abandoned, its training halls empty, its courtyard covered in leaves and dust. Upon a dais in its sealed temple rests a topaz cauldron filled with ancient ash, remnants of a pyre for the warrior-poet Xin. For three generations, Xin taught his acolytes the Bonds of the Guardian Flame, a series of mantras to train the mind and body for the harsh realities beyond the fortress walls.

However, in teaching a warrior's way he earned a warrior's rivals, and in his autumn Xin was bested and slain. His followers spread to the wind. Yet as years turned to centuries and followers to descendants, his teachings endured by subtle whisper and deed. Touched by the teacher's lasting legacy, the Burning Celestial, inquisitive aspect of fire, cast himself to the Fortress of Flares and reignited the pyre ash. From these glowing embers emerged an image of Xin, wreathed in flame, his thoughtful countenance prepared to train and to teach, and to spread the fires of knowledge to all who seek guidance.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit_hype: Swift and elusive, Ember Spirit strikes all nearby enemies in rapid succession, and ties them up with burning chains. Quickly rushing across the battlefield to arrive at one of his exploding remnants, few can avoid, or capture, his flame.

However, in teaching a warrior's way he earned a warrior's rivals, and in his autumn Xin was bested and slain. His followers spread to the wind. Yet as years turned to centuries and followers to descendants, his teachings endured by subtle whisper and deed. Touched by the teacher's lasting legacy, the Burning Celestial, inquisitive aspect of fire, cast himself to the Fortress of Flares and reignited the pyre ash. From these glowing embers emerged an image of Xin, wreathed in flame, his thoughtful countenance prepared to train and to teach, and to spread the fires of knowledge to all who seek guidance.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Affects random units, without priorities, within the radius centered around Xin.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** Has the following remnant cast sequence:
**** Xin {{to}} Latest Created Remnant {{to}} Next Latest Created Remnant {{to}} ... {{to}} Earliest Created Remnant
*** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Inter}}
**** Multiple overlapping Searing Chains radius do not stack.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|ember_spirit_searing_chains}}
** Applies the following effects on affected units:
*** {{M|Root}}
*** {{M|True Sight}} over the affected enemy units.
*** Deals {{#expr:{{#var:Searing Chains value3}}*{{#var:Searing Chains basic1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t3l}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Searing Chains value3 tal}}*{{#var:Searing Chains basic1}}}}|20tal}}) {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} ([[before reductions]]) in {{#var:Searing Chains basic1}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Searing Chains basic1}} seconds upon debuff application, over {{calc|trunc(v1/{{#var:Searing Chains basic1}})|v1={{#var:Searing Chains value4}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t2l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|trunc(v1/{{#var:Searing Chains basic1}})|v1={{#var:Searing Chains value4 tal}}}}|15tal}}) damage instances.
** Reapplying the debuff refreshes the duration, but does not update the ability values.

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}

*** Explicitly self-[[disarm]]s until all marked targets are affected by the dashed {{M|instant attack}}.
*** Other disarm sources applied on Xin prevent the instant attack component during the dash.
*** The disarm duration is defined as:
**** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Disarm]]Duration {{=}} DashDuration {{=}} {{#var:Sleight of Fist value3}} × ( (Σ MarkedTargets - 1) + f(DoubleImpact) )}}
*** Has the following properties during the dash:
**** {{M|Invulnerability}}
***** When {{Code|DashDuration > [[Projectile]]TravelTime}}, projectiles may be negated by the granted invulnerability.
**** {{M|Unselectable}}
** [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px]] {{hi|Ember Spirit}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} [[File:Dota2 PtoP.png|21px]] {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px]]
*** Positions Xin {{#var:Sleight of Fist basic1}}-distance away from the marked unit, on a line between the first target and the ability's cast location.
**** {{Code|OP {{=}} {{#var:Sleight of Fist basic1}}}}
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}}

*#** Do not have {{M|True Strike}}.

*#* This ability component can only be interrupted under the following conditions:
*#** Upon an {{A|Ember Spirit|Activate Fire Remnant}} cast.
*#** Upon Xin's {{M|death}}.
*#* {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Conditional}}
*#** Sleight of Fist is a bonus [[conditional attack damage]] source and has the following properties:
*#*** The enemy hero bonus attack damage values are directly added to Xin's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}} and not displayed on the [[HUD]].
*#*** Considers enemy {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes; other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
*#** Does not interact with the following sources:
*#*** Percentage-based {{M|bonus attack damage|x}} sources.
*#** Interacts with the following sources:
*#*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#**** {{M|Critical strike}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
*#***** {{hi|Ember Spirit}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{Symbol|Target|Cleave90|size=42px}}
*#***** The ability area-of-effect corresponds to Xin's ability cast {{M|facing angle}}, regardless of the ability's visual effects.
*#**** {{M|Lifesteal}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Spell lifesteal}} sources.
*#*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#**** {{M|Damage block}} sources.
*# Applies an {{A|Ember Spirit|Immolation}} instance of its correpsonding level.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_ember_spirit
data.bio_loc:
Lost within the Wailing Mountains, the Fortress of Flares lay abandoned, its training halls empty, its courtyard covered in leaves and dust. Upon a dais in its sealed temple rests a topaz cauldron filled with ancient ash, remnants of a pyre for the warrior-poet Xin. For three generations, Xin taught his acolytes the Bonds of the Guardian Flame, a series of mantras to train the mind and body for the harsh realities beyond the fortress walls.

However, in teaching a warrior's way he earned a warrior's rivals, and in his autumn Xin was bested and slain. His followers spread to the wind. Yet as years turned to centuries and followers to descendants, his teachings endured by subtle whisper and deed. Touched by the teacher's lasting legacy, the Burning Celestial, inquisitive aspect of fire, cast himself to the Fortress of Flares and reignited the pyre ash. From these glowing embers emerged an image of Xin, wreathed in flame, his thoughtful countenance prepared to train and to teach, and to spread the fires of knowledge to all who seek guidance.
data.hype_loc: Swift and elusive, Ember Spirit strikes all nearby enemies in rapid succession, and ties them up with burning chains. Quickly rushing across the battlefield to arrive at one of his exploding remnants, few can avoid, or capture, his flame.
data.npe_desc_loc: Rapidly strikes and chains his foes

abilities.name: ember_spirit_immolation
abilities.desc_loc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
notes_loc: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
abilities.shard_loc: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.

abilities.name: ember_spirit_fire_remnant
abilities.desc_loc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
abilities.lore_loc: By the spirit's power are Xin's teachings spread anew.
abilities.shard_loc: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
